parameters.name: AnycastEipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address that is allocated to the Anycast EIP.

parameters.name: AnycastId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anycast EIP.

>  To ensure the accuracy of the query result, we do not recommend that you specify **AnycastIds** and **AnycastId** at the same time.

parameters.name: AnycastIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of Anycast EIPs.

You can enter at most 50 Anycast EIP IDs.

>  To ensure the accuracy of the query result, we do not recommend that you specify **AnycastIds** and **AnycastId** at the same time.

parameters.name: BindInstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the cloud resources with which the Anycast EIPs are associated.

You can enter at most 100 cloud resource IDs.

parameters.name: BusinessStatus
parameters.description:
The service status of the Anycast EIP. Valid values:

*   **Normal**
*   **FinancialLocked**

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the Anycast EIP.

Set the value to **PostPaid**, which specifies the pay-as-you-go billing method.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description:
The metering method of the Anycast EIP.

Set the value to **PayByTraffic**, which specifies the pay-by-data-transfer metering method.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **20 to 100**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the Anycast EIP.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must start with a letter.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
*   You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: ServiceLocation
parameters.description:
The access area of the Anycast EIP.

Set the value to **international**, which specifies the regions outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the Anycast EIP. Valid values:

*   **Associating**
*   **Unassociating**
*   **Allocated**
*   **Associated**
*   **Modifying**
*   **Releasing**
*   **Released**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eipanycast list-anycast-eip-addresses --anycast-id aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --anycast-ids aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --anycast-eip-address 139.95.XX.XX --service-location international --instance-charge-type PostPaid --internet-charge-type PayByTraffic --name doctest --resource-group-id rg-aekzthsmwsnfuni --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --max-results 50 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --status Associated --business-status Normal --bind-instance-ids lb-2zebb08phyczzawe0000 --region cn-hangzhou
